arms.better: tm eventually found the decoder and implemented the BOM trim, but the run spent 81 calls and its recorded input was 7.7M tokens for this narrow fix; it could improve by converging on the map-decoder and regression test earlier and reducing repeated broad searches. The run output also exposed raw tool/API failures (the submission-evidence invariant and the unrecognized `test-output` artifact kind) before recovering, which is confusing to users even when retries succeed. A concise end summary should state the changed files, exact verification command and result, elapsed time, and token usage.

OpenCode located `UnmarshalToMap`, made the focused implementation change and added TOML, YAML, and JSON regression cases, then ran `go test ./parser/metadecoders` and accurately reported success. It could improve further by explicitly noting that the fix PR's hidden test files were independently overlaid after the run and that the prescribed package-level verification passed.
